Name: Ahihud, Son of Shelomi
Summary: Ahihud, Son of Shelomi was the prince of Asher appointed to divide the land of Canaan by inheritance among the tribes.
KeyStory: Ahihud was named by the LORD, with Eleazar and Joshua, to apportion the promised land to the nine and a half tribes.
LifeLesson: Dividing what God gives takes honest hands.
